messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “sweet spot” for visiting Hawaii is typically late spring through early fall—specifically **April, May, September, and October**.  

| Month | Avg. High (°F) | Avg. Low (°F) | Why it’s good |
|-------|----------------|---------------|---------------|
| April | ~81 °F | ~66 °F | Warm but not scorching; lower crowds after the holiday season. |
| May   | ~83 °F | ~68 °F | Pleasant beach weather; still off‑peak for many resorts. |
| September | ~84 °F | ~69 °F | Post‑summer crowds thin out; great surf conditions. |
| October | ~82 °F | ~67 °F | Mild temperatures; fewer tourists; still plenty of sunshine. |

These months strike a balance between comfortable temperatures, lower accommodation rates, and fewer crowds compared to peak summer (June–August) and holiday periods (December–January). If you’re looking for the absolute best weather, late spring (April–May) tends to have the most consistent, sunny days with minimal rainfall.
